@@U01411@@
small, it still needs tending.
We have no household help,
and so I cook and sweep,
knit and sew,
and run errands—
I’m always on my feet—
and mother will be so strict about just everything!
Not that we have to be, you know,
we could be freer with money than most.
My father left us a tidy sum,
and a cottage and garden just outside town.
But I live mainly a quiet life now.
My brother’s a soldier,
my little sister’s dead.
I had some difficult times with her,
but I'd gladly live them all over again,
I loved her so.

@@U01413@@
She must have been an angel if she was like you.

@@U01415@@
I brought her up myself.
Oh, she loved me so!
She was born after my father died.
We gave up mother for lost,
she was so badly off. But then,
little by little she began to come round.
Still, of course, she couldn’t dream of
nursing the poor thing, she was so weak,
so I made do feeding it with milk and water,
and that’s how she came to be mine.
And so she grew big,
in my arms, on my lap,
squirming, kicking, smiling.

@@U01417@@
That must have been the sheerest happiness for you.
translation:
@@U01411@@
虽小，仍需照料。
我们没有家务助理，
于是我又做饭又扫地，
针织和缝纫，
并跑腿——
我总是站起来——
妈妈对任何事情都会那么严格！
并不是说我们必须如此，你知道，
我们可以比大多数人更自由地使用金钱。
我父亲给我们留下了一大笔钱，
镇外还有一座小屋和花园。
但我现在主要过着平静的生活。
我的兄弟是一名军人，
我的妹妹死了。
我和她一起度过了一段艰难的时光
但我很乐意重新经历一遍，
我是如此爱她。

@@U01413@@
如果她像你一样，她一定是天使。

@@U01415@@
我自己把她带大的。
哦，她是如此爱我！
她是我父亲去世后出生的。
我们因迷失而放弃了母亲，
她的处境如此糟糕。但随后，
渐渐地，她开始清醒过来。
当然，她仍然无法梦想
照顾这个可怜的东西，她是如此虚弱，
所以我就用牛奶和水喂它，
这就是她成为我的原因。
就这样她长大了，
在我的怀里，在我的腿上，
蠕动、踢腿、微笑。

@@U01417@@
这对你来说一定是最纯粹的幸福。
